name: fibroblast growth factor 1
pathways: positive regulation of MAP kinase activity

function.text: FGF1 encodes fibroblast growth factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and heparin binding. It participates in positive regulation of MAP kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
